_comment: Overrides for scripts/appimage-notices.py, which the release and build
workflows run on the Tauri AppImage right after building it. Every file in
the AppDir that no Ubuntu package on the build host owns must be listed
here, as own (this project's, or generated at build time) or under 'files'
(mapped to an 'extra' component with its license texts). Paths are
AppDir-relative fnmatch patterns; license_files are relative to this file.
Texts in appimage/: the type2-runtime set from the shared licfix linux
recipe (pinned upstream refs and SHA-256 in its licenses/README.md),
commit 35058592f5) and the license header of AppImageKit's src/AppRun.c
(commit 2b8f5b39c4; the file last changed in 142d826bd7). common_licenses
names the text to ship where a copyright file cites a common-licenses name

own.reason: The app's own executable, built from this repository (its crates and web frontend are in Third-Party-Notices.txt)
The app's desktop entry, written by the Tauri bundler
The app's icons (src-tauri/icons, drawn for this project)
Copy of the app's icon at the AppDir root, for the AppImage desktop integration
Four-line launcher script that linuxdeploy writes at build time to source the GTK hook and run AppRun.wrapped
Generated at build time by linuxdeploy-plugin-gtk (gdk-pixbuf-query-loaders): paths of the bundled loaders
Generated at build time by linuxdeploy-plugin-gtk (gtk-query-immodules-3.0): paths of the bundled input methods
Generated at build time by linuxdeploy-plugin-gtk (glib-compile-schemas) from the bundled schema files, which the host packages own
Generated at build time by linuxdeploy-plugin-gtk (gio-querymodules): names the bundled GIO modules and their extension points

files.reason: Tauri's bundler downloads AppRun-x86_64 from tauri-apps/binary-releases (release apprun-old, a mirror of AppImageKit's continuous build); linuxdeploy renames it when it adds the GTK hook. The v0.3.0 AppImage's copy is byte-identical to that asset

Hook script written by linuxdeploy-plugin-gtk. Tauri's bundler (tauri-cli 2.12) runs its own copy of the tauri-apps fork, crates/tauri-bundler/src/bundle/linux/appimage/linuxdeploy-plugin-gtk.sh in tauri-apps/tauri

common_licenses.reason: Ubuntu 22.04's pango copyright files (libpango-1.0-0, libpangocairo-1.0-0, libpangoft2-1.0-0, gir1.2-pango-1.0) cite /usr/share/common-licenses/GPL-2.0 for the GNU GPL version 2; base-files names that text GPL-2
The same pango copyright files cite /usr/share/common-licenses/GPL-3.0 for the GNU GPL version 3; base-files names that text GPL-3

extra.name: AppImageKit AppRun
extra.reason: AppRun.wrapped is AppImageKit's AppRun.c, compiled by its CI; the text is that file's license header

extra.name: linuxdeploy-plugin-gtk
extra.reason: Its hook script ships in apprun-hooks/

extra.name: AppImage type2-runtime
extra.license: MIT AND LGPL-2.1-only AND BSD-2-Clause AND BSD-3-Clause AND Zlib
sources: Statically links libfuse {libfuse_version} (LGPL-2.1, patched by patches/libfuse in the runtime source): https://github.com/libfuse/libfuse/releases/tag/fuse-{libfuse_version}
Statically links musl (MIT), zstd {zstd_version} (BSD-3-Clause) and zlib {zlib_version} (Zlib) from the Alpine Linux release named in the runtime source's scripts/chroot/chroot_build.sh
extra.reason: The runtime is the AppImage's ELF header, outside the squashfs, so no host package owns it. Its texts are vendored from upstream; the runtime commit pins the exact sources (v0.3.0 used 8f39b89 with libfuse 3.15.0, squashfuse 0.5.2, zstd 1.5.6 and zlib 1.3.2)
